name: Empty State

representativeVariants.title: 还没有任务
representativeVariants.supporting: 创建第一个任务后，它会出现在这里。

representativeVariants.title: 暂无内容
representativeVariants.supporting: 当前还没有可展示的内容。

representativeVariants.title: 未找到相关结果
representativeVariants.supporting: 没有符合当前关键词和筛选条件的结果。

structurePatterns: centered vertical column: optional neutral visual, title, supporting text, actions
visual is optional and remains neutral/subtle; Empty State does not use Success/Danger decoration to imply an outcome
at most one visually primary action; optional secondary text action
no-results keeps current query/filter context visible or recoverable and offers a way to broaden or clear constraints
usageHints: use only for absence: first-use, no-data, or no-results
copy explains why content is absent and the next useful action when one exists
no-results is contextual to the active query/filter state, not a global product empty state
recoverable failure belongs to Result/Blocking/Alert semantics, not Empty State
doNotInvent: no recoverable-error variant in new V2 designs
no Success/Danger color as default empty decoration
